core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Marwah corresponds to the Arabic form مروة (Arabic مَرْوَة (Marwa)). Its core sense is marwa; a female given name and place name. Marwah is Arabic مَرْوَة (Marwa), a documented female given name and the name of a hill in Mecca. The source gloss 'Source of water' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same name as marva, marwa and marwat.
